scope: Static read-only financial/reporting composition review; no fresh execution and no proof of authentic complete logs.

families.name: Projection and per-currency availability
cases: Unrevealed/dormant/missing IDs and contradictory activation/share/weight state; nonexistent identity does not become a fabricated zero position.
Broken optional currency metadata/claim view vs core runtime/controller failure; only affected optional balance fields may be unavailable, work/deployment failures still abort.
Native custody deferral/recovery and current-owner transfer; derived stage remains separate from permanently activated entitlement.
Wallet inventory count, snapshot confirmation/freshness and complete chunks; missing LP valuation cannot silently make a smaller total.
families.assessment: No reproducible additional defect found; existing runtime/ABI/chain/canonical checks and limits retained.

families.name: Earnings arithmetic and denomination
cases: Old versus new member fee allocation, source fractions, carried dust and tiny raw units.
Claim, conversion, imported backing and custody return are not new earned revenue; converted ETH is not valued a second time as new income.
Zero original earned amount with no price can be zero; positive amount with missing/stale/mismatched source price stays null.
Current lower-bound dual USD price marks original earned currencies rather than pretending to be historic USD or current claimable money.
families.assessment: No reproducible additional defect found; exact funding/index/paid reconciliation is separate from provider independence and economic qualification.

families.name: History, ancestry and ownership
cases: Missing mint/transfer, wrong emitter/topic/word/recipient/asset, duplicate provenance, repeated transaction across blocks and removed/orphaned logs fail closed.
Same-chain predecessor order, both retirement/activation directions, matching source root/IDs, exact creation and cutoff anchors; no legacy codec relabeling.
Snapshot-consistent SQLite reads, bounded events/records, no latest-block fallback and reconciliation before destructive reorg writes.
Legitimate payout callback may transfer the NFT before Claimed emits; the recorded authorized recipient need not equal owner at the emitted-log moment.
families.assessment: No new reproducible defect found; indexed complete ingestion is operator-maintained evidence, not a consensus/log-completeness proof.

families.name: Wallet lifetime/current holdings
cases: No holdings versus beyond-end cursor, offset alignment, selected16NFT bounded chunks and a1000NFT upper bound.
Transferred NFTs include lifetime prior-owner NFT earnings, not wallet-tenure income; same block/inventory is required before summing chunks.
Newly minted successor NFTs absent from predecessor epochs must match ordinal chronology; full configured lineage required.
families.assessment: No additional reproducible defect found; final target-chain/provider/capacity service acceptance remains open.

observations.details: Exact initial view/simulation output equality is conditional on inert callbacks. A contract owner may donate ETH to royalty pending funds or claim another ledger before a later batch entry. A generic equality veto would reject supported flows. Root informed; no source change here.

unresolved_limits: Optional-token failure may make full processed earnings unavailable even when healthy ETH NFT balances remain available. Do not replace unknown history with zero.
Authentic complete historical logs and source prices need actual provider/archive/replay qualification.
Public current3 website/service acceptance and real operating capacity remain unqualified.
